name: jm-income-tax
description: Jamaica personal income tax for year of assessment 2026, for resident and non-resident individuals, self-employed persons filing Form S04 and S04a, and employees with other income. Covers the income tax threshold (J$1,902,360 a year from 1 April 2026, effective J$1,876,614 for 2026), the 25% and 30% rates and the J$6 million break on statutory income, pension and age reliefs, Education Tax, NHT and NIS for the self-employed, the prior-year loss restriction, filing on 15 March and quarterly estimates. Trigger on Jamaica income tax, TAJ, S04, S04a, IT01, statutory income, tax-free threshold, self-employed tax Jamaica, Education Tax, NHT, NIS. Built from Tax Administration Jamaica publications; not reviewed by an accountant.
